items.title: Australia Orders LNG Exporters Reserve Some Gas to Plug Shortages at Home
items.summary: Australia will require liquefied natural gas exporters to reserve up to a fifth of their shipments for the domestic market to help lower power bills for local households and businesses.

items.title: Bad News for Exxon and Chevron: Goldman Sees Brent Falling “Roughly $10” Next Year on a Supply Glut
